caption: The drawing features an aerial view of a landscaped estate labeled “The Hopkins Estate” from “Blackwell’s Survey.” The composition is mainly green, with multiple shades representing grassy fields, clusters of trees, and shrubbery. At the top left, there is a rectangular vegetable or flower garden divided into five sections, each filled with small, colorful dots and shapes depicting individual plants, and surrounded by a border of green and red. A building with a red, multi-gabled roof is situated centrally near the top right next to a curved driveway lined by small bushes. Adjacent to the building is a circular or oval green lawn bordered by a white path, dotted with small, dark figures suggesting people. Smaller, kidney-shaped patches of ground, one with beds of pink flowers, appear on the left side of the main circular path, while another fenced-in patch with sparse vegetation is in the lower left. Rows of evenly spaced trees line the paths and the boundaries of some areas. The background consists of open lawns with a few scattered coniferous trees depicted with dark green brushstrokes. The overall color palette consists of olive and grass greens, accents of red and pink for the rooftops and flowers, and white paths, with the whole image bordered by a beige frame.
title: J. Hopkins Estate
